senses.gloss: Ushman (B. Ūshº), name of a fire. § 493 (Āṅgirasa): III, 221, 14179.--Cf. also III, 13969 (ºā cāgnir iti jñeyo yo 'nnaṃ pacati dehināṃ); XII, 6877 (do.).

Ushmapāḥ (pl.) (B. Ūshº) (“steam-drinkers”), a class of pitṛs or ṛshis. § 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 341 (one of the classes of pitṛs).--§ 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 109, 3780 (ºāṇāṃ devānāṃ nivāsaḥ, in the south).--§ 576 (Bhagavadgītāp.): VI, 35, †1268.--§ 695b (Dakshayajñavināśa): XII, 285, 10280.--§ 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 18, †1371.--§ 749 (do.): XIII, 91, 4352 (B. and C., by error Ushṇaº).--§ 768b (Umā-Maheśvarasaṃv.): XIII, 141, 6495.
